_help: Which supervision actions each capacity may perform, per accreditation pathway and module. Read by worker/verification/pathways.js. A capacity is recorded on each Wavelength approval (supervisor_approvals.capacity); a credential issued by an outside body is evidence for an approval, never a permission on its own. Each rule field summarises the source it names (close to its wording, not a verbatim quote). Change a rule only after reading the body's current published guidance, and update source, rule and checked. Actions: witness (directly supervise a scan in person), review (review a scan record and its images later, asynchronously), formative, summative, dops, final (final or triggered assessment, or the end-of-training sign-off). A review or sign-off in Wavelength never confers accreditation: the body decides.

actions.review: Review a scan record and its images later
actions.final: Final or triggered assessment, or end-of-training sign-off

supervisor.label: Supervisor
supervisor.about: Oversees training for the module and may sign every step the pathway allows a supervisor to sign.

trainer.label: Trainer
trainer.about: FUSIC modules other than Heart: reviews logbook scans, signs competencies and conducts the triggered assessment for the module named.

mentor.label: Mentor
mentor.about: Oversees and reviews scans and gives feedback. Cannot sign the final or triggered assessment.

local_supervisor.label: Locally approved supervisor
local_supervisor.about: Approved by the trainee's own organisation where the pathway leaves supervision to local arrangements.

famus.label: FAMUS (Society for Acute Medicine)
famus.rule: Supervisors: may undertake supervised scans, review unsupervised scans and must perform ACTs. Mentors: will review images from unsupervised scans (mentored practice); cannot sign off ACTs (these must be done by a Supervisor). Supervisors must apply to the FAMUS administrator and be registered on the database. A mentor must be competent in performing the scan they intend to oversee and can be any grade clinician.
famus.asyncReview: Permitted for mentored practice: mentors and supervisors review images from unsupervised scans. Directly supervised scans are overseen in person.

famus-pva.rule: In contrast with other FAMUS modules, registration with the Society is not required and supervision is to be determined at a local level.
famus-pva.note: Peripheral vascular access: sign-off is local, not through SAM-registered supervisors. A FAMUS supervisor listing does not cover it.

fusic.label: FUSIC (Intensive Care Society)
fusic._capacities: supervisor: approvals granted before capacities existed (October 2026) keep their meaning; record new FUSIC approvals outside Heart as trainer.
fusic.rule: Trainers review logbook scans, sign off competencies and conduct a mentee's triggered assessment, and sign off the summary training record to confirm that a mentee has satisfactorily completed all the training components. Trainers apply for a named module (Lung, Abdomen, Vascular, DVT or Haemodynamics) after at least 12 months' accreditation in it.
fusic.asyncReview: Logbook scan review by the module's trainer.

fusic-heart.rule: Supervisors must conduct the triggered assessment and countersign the summary training record to confirm that a mentee has satisfactorily completed all the training components. Mentors assess logbooks and are involved in triggered assessments with supervisors; mentors need an identified supervisor.
fusic-heart.note: FUSIC Heart has two roles. A mentor never signs the triggered assessment or the summary record as the final signatory.

rcem.label: RCEM
rcem.rule: RCEM publishes no register of ultrasound supervisors: supervision and the entrustment decision are local.
rcem.asyncReview: Logbook review is local practice; DOPS are directly observed.
